description: Hourly Consumption by Postal Code (1000 to 2000) is a dataset listed in E-REDES open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution operator, published or maintained by E-REDES (Portugal). This DataSet is built based on load diagrams collected by smart meters. In cases where there are still no meters capable of carrying out these collections, or there is difficulty in communicating with them, a profile of consumption is carried out. Consult here the document that systematizes the estimation methodology of the different profiles. Coverage: Portugal. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Consumption and Energy. Its keywords are internal. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eredes-open-data-portal.
